_comment: The Hammunition Hill palette. The two brand colours are sampled from the
logo artwork itself, not chosen beside it: #912795 and #ed9a1c are the two
most common chromatic values in docs/images/logo.png. brand-deep is the
shadow tone the artwork already uses under the purple.
The dashboard accent is the brand purple lightened to be readable. #912795
itself is 2.62:1 against the ground, and the accent is text: active tabs,
links, callsigns. Same hue, raised to 7.1:1. tests/test_contrast.py holds
the floor, and web/style.css is the source of truth for these values.
